releaseNotes: v260: Adds a local, read-only audit of all same-origin LocalStorage keys and IndexedDB records, plus structural source comparison. Exports a JSON report; performs no migration, writes, reset or deletion.
v259: Marking an invoice as paid waits for the IndexedDB accounting shadow write and verifies the complete accounting snapshot by read-back. A clear warning is shown if verification fails.
v258: Marking an invoice as unpaid waits for the IndexedDB accounting shadow write and verifies the complete accounting snapshot by read-back. A clear warning is shown if verification fails.
v257: Fix invoice paid-date validation so valid ISO payment dates are accepted.

v256: Saving or editing an invoice now waits for the queued IndexedDB accounting shadow write and verifies the complete accounting snapshot by read-back. This includes invoice-linked income when the invoice is marked paid. LocalStorage remains authoritative; no migration or deletion.

v255: Customer deletion now waits for the queued IndexedDB accounting shadow write and verifies the complete accounting snapshot by read-back. Customers linked to invoices remain protected from deletion. LocalStorage remains authoritative; no migration or automatic deletion.

v254: Saving or editing a customer now waits for the queued IndexedDB accounting shadow write and verifies the full accounting snapshot by read-back. LocalStorage remains authoritative; failed IndexedDB verification produces a warning and does not roll back the saved customer. No migration, reset, or data deletion.

v253: Add Entry awaits the queued IndexedDB shadow write and verifies the stored accounting snapshot by read-back before showing completion. LocalStorage remains authoritative; on an unconfirmed IndexedDB copy, the user receives a warning. No automatic migration, reset, or data deletion.
v252 adds an explicit, user-confirmed, non-overwriting Accounting snapshot copy from LocalStorage to IndexedDB, with read-back verification.
v251 adds a read-only diagnostic comparing Accounting LocalStorage with the IndexedDB appState snapshot.
